# World Solitaire

> Free Klondike Solitaire online — no ads, no sign-up, mobile and desktop.

World Solitaire is a browser-based Klondike card game with country leaderboards, winnable deals, fullscreen mode, and guides on rules and strategy. Audience: casual and competitive solitaire players. Focused topics: Klondike Solitaire gameplay, rules, strategy, win rate tips.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://world-solitaire.com/): Play Klondike free — overview, features, how to play
- [English](https://world-solitaire.com/en/): English game page and guide hub
- [Russian](https://world-solitaire.com/ru/): Русская версия игры
- [Turkish](https://world-solitaire.com/tr/): Türkçe oyun sayfası

Other locales (same game UI): /bg/ /cs/ /da/ /de/ /el/ /es/ /et/ /fi/ /fr/ /he/ /hr/ /hu/ /it/ /ja/ /ko/ /lt/ /lv/ /nb/ /nl/ /pl/ /pt/ /ro/ /sk/ /sl/ /sr/ /sv/
